Product Overview | ESP32 is a single 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi-and-Bluetooth combo chip designed with the TSMC low-power 40 nm | technology. It is designed to achieve the best power and RF performance, showing robustness, versatility and | reliability in a wide variety of applications and power scenarios. | For details on part numbers and ordering information, please refer to Section 1 ESP32 Series Comparison.
